ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with a contrast ratio of approximately 94:6 relative to high-intensity white localized markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white pixels are mapped to localized circular rings and spots. Significant cluster at the distal tip of the left lobe. Scattered individual rings across the central and right ventral regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 130-140 degrees, positioned centrally between the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular peaks and valleys along the entire margin. The right lobe displays higher amplitude indentations compared to the more uniform jagged edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curvature on both lobes extending from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular white high-contrast clusters. A dense constellation is visible on the far left lobe; isolated rings are visible in the central-right lower quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, low-contrast horizontal linear disruptions are detectable on the right lobe surface, cutting through the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular rosette scarring patterns across both lobes; significant jagged material loss or irregular growth on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct, high-intensity white circular spots located at the extreme upper-right distal tip.
